verdict.rationale: Chronicle Labs is an agent simulation, evaluation and observability platform, so user-defined event-triggered automation is a fair question for it. However, no evidence shows a way to author rules that fire actions on events. The closest items do not qualify: SDK workflow automation is a developer building block. 'Autonomous fix and rollback' monitoring is an adjacent vendor-driven behavior with no user-defined rules or triggers. Scorer pass thresholds evaluate test results rather than trigger actions.
